title: Project directory gets a new music experiment
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: one new community project, clearer terms, and a link pointed back at reality.

Musify, an AI-enhanced music streaming project, joined the project list—another visible use of Pollinations infrastructure in the wild.

The terms prompt gained a compliance section, and an outdated URL was refreshed. Not glamorous work, but fewer dead links and clearer terms are how public infrastructure stays usable.
